about: Transition presets the renderer knows, what each one means, and its length in frames at 30 fps per direction. A storyboard names one for every cut; the meaning column is the reason it is there.

presets.dip: a breath between chapters: out through paper (editorial) or black (documentary), then in
presets.match: a match cut on scale: the same shape or color carries from one frame into the next
presets.wipe: turning a page: the next month pushes the last one off
presets.iris: closing in on one subject: a person, a place
presets.whip: a whip pan into a new chapter, with motion blur
presets.bars: two palette bars sweep across and the next chapter is under them
presets.slide: the next card pushes the last one out on a spring
